rows.claim: The two-state polynomial gives the exact values of the full matrix's fast pair
rows.fix: whose characteristic polynomial s² + 6.14 s + 29.5 has ωn = 5.43 rad/s and ζ = 0.566, the values of the full matrix's fast pair to the figures given (5.4326 and 0.5660 in full)
rows.note: The reduced pair is 5.4304 and 0.5657 (probe:66-67), the full pair 5.4326 and 0.5660 (probe:62). The V coupling (A[2,1] = 0.0078) makes the reduction approximate, not exact.

rows.claim: All three loops are built from library components and one leaf of the example's own, Altimeter
rows.fix: The three loops are built from the plant, library components and, from `autopilot` on, one more leaf of the example's own, `Altimeter`.
rows.note: pitch_hold has no Altimeter, and the plant Longitudinal is itself a leaf of the example.

rows.claim: The tracker, altitude loop and airspeed loop stay within a few hundredths during the maneuver
rows.note: The standby tracker gap is 0.034 rad after 0.5 s but peaks at 0.43 rad at the step (probe2:208; companion line 435 says so itself). The outer loops' gaps during the climb were not probed, and the sentence does not say where the fast part ends.

rows.claim: The pitch-rate and attitude loops sit a few hundredths of a radian off whatever Tt is
rows.note: Gaps after 15 s are 0.010 for the pitch-rate loop (probe:277) and 0.037 for the attitude loop (test comment at line 281). The claim that Tt does not matter needs a Tt sweep, and closed_loop hard-codes Tt = 0.02.

rows.claim: A controller in command at Tt = one period pulls a limited integrator back within a tick
rows.fix: A controller in command back-calculates against its limits, and at one period it pulls a limited integrator back by the fraction 1 − e⁻¹ of its excess in each tick.
rows.note: The correction step is β = −expm1(−Δt/Tt), 0.632 at Tt = Δt, so the excess falls to 0.37 of its size per tick and does not vanish. Only Tt = 0 is instant (pid_anti_windup.md section 9). The closed_loop docstring (examples/src/longitudinal.jl:435) repeats the sentence.

rows.claim: The tracker's own limits are the actuators' ranges
rows.fix: The tracker's own limits are the cascade's innermost limits, ±0.5 rad on the elevator and 0 to 1 on the throttle.
rows.note: The actuators group has rate limiters and lags and no range. The tracker's u_min and u_max repeat the q_ctl and V_ctl limits.

rows.claim: The standby tracker gap is back under 0.1 rad within 55 ms of the step
rows.fix: is back under 0.1 rad within 60 ms
rows.note: Gap series at the 5 ms snapshots: 0.4289 at 5.0 s, 0.3319 at 5.02, 0.1103 at 5.04 to 5.055, 0.0242 at 5.06. It first falls under 0.1 at 5.06 s, 60 ms after the step.
